name: Testcontainers
summary: Throwaway Docker containers for databases, brokers and services, started from test code and removed when the tests finish.
strengths: Real dependencies instead of in-memory fakes.
Every run gets clean state, so tests never fight over data.
Modules for Postgres, Kafka, Redis, LocalStack and many more.
tradeoffs: Needs Docker on developer machines and CI runners.
Container start-up adds seconds per suite unless reused.
